fixture_purpose: A duplicate ProcessContinuation after prompt_sent must not rewind lifecycle state or send a second provider prompt.

implemented.mechanism: prompt_sent-or-later rows are classified as PromptAlreadySent before provider I/O; the worker moves them to needs_continuation_reconciliation/duplicate_prompt_prevented and does not call ACP. provider_send is also ledgered with an INSERT OR IGNORE guard before prompt_sent.
